title: Personal Anomaly Day Finder
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anomalyday:score
| search anomaly_score=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(anomaly_score) as avg_anomaly_score max(anomaly_score) as max_anomaly_score by _time domain
| sort - _time
description: Tracks personal anomaly-day scores over time and breaks it out by domain.
value: Day-level anomaly scoring is the cleanest way to find the weird days worth explaining across the whole personal index.
implementation: Send personal anomaly-day scores events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of personal anomaly-day scores by domain.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how personal anomaly-day scores changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
